value.name: Asha agrees to inspect property
value.description: Asha says she prefers to see the property herself, accepting the visit despite Lucia staying home.
evidence: "Lucia has preferred to stay in the house this week, and it seemed easier."
"It's fine," Asha said. "I prefer to see the property in any case."

value.name: Daniel proposes accepting buyer offer
value.description: Daniel presents a buyer's increased offer and says he wants to accept it quickly.
evidence: "The buyer's agent has been in touch again. They're prepared to come up to seven-twenty. That's a strong number for this block in this condition. They want a thirty-day close. I'd like to accept."

value.name: Lucia objects to Daniel
value.description: Lucia interrupts Daniel when he says he wants to accept the offer.

value.name: Daniel seeks probate guidance
value.description: Daniel repeats that he wants to accept the offer, framing it as contingent on Asha's probate advice and claiming the will is clear.
evidence: "I'd like to accept," he repeated, to Asha, as if his sister had not spoken, "subject obviously to your guidance on probate timing. Halloran told me the will is clean and that there's no reason we can't move."

value.name: Asha tests the will understanding
value.description: Asha pauses the conversation and asks Daniel and Lucia to confirm their understanding of the 2020 will and its terms.
evidence: "Mr. Serrano," she said. "Before we talk about offers, I'd like to confirm what's in front of us. The will I have is the one your mother executed in 2020. It leaves the house and contents jointly to the two of you, in equal shares, with you named as executor. Is that your understanding?"

value.name: Daniel confirms will terms
value.description: Daniel agrees that Asha's description of the will matches his understanding.

value.name: Lucia hesitates over will details
value.description: Lucia avoids directly answering Asha's question, first deferring to Halloran's copy of the will.
evidence: Lucia opened her mouth. Closed it. Looked down at her mug. "That's the will Mr. Halloran has, yes."

value.name: Asha presses Lucia for direct answer
value.description: Asha rejects Lucia's evasive reply and asks again for a direct confirmation.

value.name: Lucia hardens emotionally
value.description: Lucia looks up with a changed expression, suggesting her grief has turned into something colder and harder.
evidence: Lucia looked up. Her eyes were not red anymore; they had passed through red into something flatter and harder
